# Castle source metadata

Selected live generation and exact model-version metadata acquired 2026-09-12
using Remixfun's Python HTTP importer for https://civitai.com/images/141866240.
User/social fields, galleries and transient signed model URLs are excluded.
The recipe records an externally generated SDXL image, DPM++ 2M SDE / Karras,
and both a hash-only A1111 model reference and matching Civitai version evidence.

Source preview bytes remain in ignored local artifacts. Preview SHA-256:
`cb6a7607fbb2d4bcc51fc30e1d490734106896362edf985eb546dfe234b63602`.
Tests replay metadata and use owned image/model bytes; they do not establish
real generation or source equality.
`parameters.txt` is the embedded generation text from the downloaded source PNG;
the replay test verifies its core fields agree with the page metadata.
